For protein, beans. Beans are one of the best superfoods out there, they are high in protein and a bunch of other stuff, and they can be used in a variety of meals. I'm not even vegetarian, but two meals a week for me is beans because they are just full of nutrients.

There are also nuts, grains, milks, and of course, tofu. Failing all that, I'm sure there are some vegetarian protein supplements out there too. It's really not very hard, even on a vegetarian diet, to hit protein macros. You aren't going to need a huge amount, less than 100g easily, but there are calculators online for this.
